messages:
sara: Heads up — our staging DAST run bounced into auth errors after yesterday's RBAC change. Scanner kept retrying and a token showed up in the staging http-access logs. Not sure if it's a false-positive but filing here so we can triage quickly.

ben: Ugh. Do we have the raw scanner stdout or the log line? Can you paste an obfuscated excerpt (no full secrets) and timestamp?

sara: Pasted obfuscated snippet below (scrubbed token). Happened ~2026-02-18T11:07:22Z.
```
[2026-02-18T11:07:22Z] staging-proxy GET /api/auth -> 401 + body contains "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...REDACTED..."
[2026-02-18T11:07:23Z] dast-runner-42 POST /scan/start -> 403
```

alex-m: Thanks. Quick context: yesterday infra applied RBAC role rename `svc/dast-runner -> svc/dast-scan` and we rotated the staging KMS key as part of a cleanup. Could be either RBAC mismatch causing 403 or a misconfigured scanner credential that fell back to logging the token.

luis: Can someone run a quick CloudTrail/Stackdriver filter for accesses to the KMS key and for PUT/POST from the scanner service account around that time? Example AWS CLI filters: `aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /staging/proxy --filter-pattern "Authorization: Bearer" --start-time 1676720000000 --end-time 1676721000000` — adjust epoch ms.

ben: I'll run the queries. Also, @sec-bot — did you auto-create an incident on KMS rotation last night?

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-023. Tagging owners: infra-oncall, sec-oncall. KMS key rotation completed 2026-02-18T02:12:00Z.

oncall: Taking lead for now. First priority: contain leakage risk and stop scanner from recording tokens in logs. Proposed immediate mitigations: (1) disable scanner credential in staging (revoke token), (2) flip DAST to unauthenticated mode for now, (3) remove Authorization header logging in the proxy config, (4) preserve evidence for audit. Thoughts? :warning:

alex-m: Agree. Also: add a short patch to the proxy to mask Authorization headers at logging layer: https://example/repo/proxy -> add middleware that does: `req.headers['authorization'] = '[REDACTED]'` before any structured logging. We should push to staging hotfix branch and redeploy canary.

luis: On audit backfill — the RBAC rename means some accesses are showing under new principal and older logs reference old name. We need to produce a canonical mapping and reconstruct access events for compliance. I propose a short script to collate: query logs, map old->new principal, and upload a signed artifact to secure-s3 for the compliance record. Sample metadata we can attach: 
```
{
  "incident": "INC-2026-023",
  "start": "2026-02-18T11:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-02-18T12:00:00Z",
  "affected_principals": ["svc/dast-runner", "svc/dast-scan"],
  "evidence_blob": "s3://redwood-sec/incidents/INC-2026-023/evidence-20260218.tar.gz"
}
```

ben: I'll assemble the log extracts and run the AWS/GCP commands. If we find token misuse outside staging, escalate immediately.

sara: One more datapoint — the scanner config file in repo `infra/dast/config.yaml` had `auth: true` and referenced `secretRef: staging/dast-token`. After the RBAC rename the token provider failed to map and apparently the runner emitted its raw header in debug logs. I'm opening a PR to default `auth: false` until we have hardened secret handling.

alex-m: Good. For longer-term: add a pre-scan check in CI that ensures DAST secrets are present and not logged (fail fast), and add an SRE alert for any log lines matching `Authorization: Bearer` in staging/prod.

oncall: Action items and owners: 
- Disable staging scanner creds (oncall)
- Mask Authorization header in proxy (alex-m)
- Collate & upload evidence + backfill mapping (ben + luis)
- PR to default auth=false (sara)
- Postmortem + compliance packet (sec-oncall)

luis: I'll draft the backfill script and post the upload command (signed URL) to the incident page. Recommend we include HMAC-signed manifest so compliance can verify tamper-evidence.

sec-bot: Ticket INC-2026-023 updated: containment in progress.

ben: Quick note — when you run the log scan, include the scanner container IDs (dast-runner-42) so we can tie any external egress attempts to a process id. If we see any exfil attempts, notify sec immediately.

sara: Deployed PR to flip `auth: false` in staging config (hotfix branch), rolling canary now. Proxy mask middleware PR opened: https://example/repo/pr/987

alex-m: Can we add a short unit test that verifies logging doesn't contain bearer tokens? e.g. assert `Authorization` not present in logged output for request simulation. I'll add it.

oncall: Thanks team — will update incident page with timeline once we have the log artifacts. If nobody objects I'll request a 4-hour postmortem meeting tomorrow. :calendar:

ben: No objections. I'll ping infra & sec for attendance.

luis: Will include mapping and signed manifest in the packet.

sara: Good job. Closing loop once evidence uploaded. :thumbsup:
